goal: Build a DeepSeek-first macOS coding agent whose verified task completion, local transparency, Chinese UX, and cost efficiency exceed Claude Code Desktop while remaining safe and recoverable.
tasks: Create editable plan and obtain approval
Run tests, lint, build, and repair failures
Validate web UI in an isolated browser
Review diff and apply line-level feedback
Commit, push, and continue from CI or review feedback
Persist checkpoints, context, cost, and recovery state
description: A native macOS local-first coding agent that can understand a repository, plan, edit, test, validate in a browser, review, recover, and deliver changes. It must use one write-owning main agent with bounded read-only specialists, DeepSeek-native model routing, strict tool contracts, checkpoints, budgets, and human approval for risky actions.

performance_requirements.scalability: small desktop installation with up to three concurrent sessions

safety_requirements: Approval for high-risk commands and network access
Secret redaction and Keychain-only API keys
Audit every tool call and permission decision
integration_requirements: Native macOS Keychain and SQLite event store
PTY terminal and isolated browser controller
Skills, MCP, Hooks, GitHub CLI/MCP, SSH Tool Host
macOS notifications and signed auto-updating app

scale_requirements.growth_projection: personal developer product with optional open-source community
